notes.title: New! Subscriptions for Typing Instructor
notes.notes: Learn to type  or brush up on your typing skills for a few dollars a month. Select from one of 20 complete Typing Plans for beginners to advanced typists. You can complete a Typing Plan in one month. There are entertaining ways to practice with lots of challenging games and activities. Bonus for families! Up to 5 users can log-in and track their own plan.
